svg.title: Colsdown 1.1.0 — Columns and stacks for Obsidian
svg.desc: A modular purple, lavender, lime, cream and orange poster with smaller, consistent lettering for resizing, nested layouts, direct editing, arrow navigation, presets and reuse.
